fields.questionText:
While playing badminton, Ravi sees a barrier chain hung between two posts at the edge of the walkway of a street. It hangs in the shape of a parabola. Based on the above information, answer the following questions:
(a) Which type of polynomial (linear, quadratic, cubic etc.) is graphically represented by a parabola?
(b) If the polynomial represented by the parabola intersects the x-axis at –2 and 3 and the y-axis at –3, write the zeroes of the polynomial.
(c) Find the expression for the above polynomial.
OR
(c) If the zeroes of a quadratic polynomial are –5 and 3, find its expression.

fields.questionText:
Assertion (A): The polynomial p(x) = x² + 3x + 3 has two real zeroes.
Reason (R): A quadratic polynomial can have at most two real zeroes.
solutionSteps: Correct option: (d). For x² + 3x + 3, b² − 4ac = 9 − 12 = −3 < 0, so it has no real zeroes — A is false. A quadratic has at most two real zeroes — R is true.
fields.finalAnswer: (d) Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.

fields.questionText: If α, β are the zeroes of the polynomial x² – 1, then the value of (α + β) is:
solutionSteps: Correct option: (d) 0. For x² − 1, a = 1, b = 0, so α + β = −b/a = 0 (zeroes are 1 and −1).

fields.questionText: If one zero of the polynomial p(x) = 6x² + 37x – (k – 2) is the reciprocal of the other, then find the value of k.
solutionSteps: [1 mark] Let the zeroes be α and 1/α. Product of zeroes = α · (1/α) = 1 = c/a = −(k − 2)/6.

fields.questionText:
The polynomial P(x) = x² − 3x − 4 models the profit (in lakh ₹, a negative value meaning a loss) of a small start-up x years after it opened.
(a) Factorise P(x) by splitting the middle term.
(b) Find the zeroes of P(x).
(c) Which zero gives a meaningful break-even time (profit zero)? Also verify the relationship between the zeroes and the coefficients of P(x).
fields.answer: (a) P(x) = (x − 4)(x + 1). (b) Zeroes: 4 and −1. (c) Only x = 4 is meaningful (time cannot be negative), so break-even is after 4 years. Sum = 3 = −(−3)/1, product = −4 = −4/1 — verified.
fields.explanation: Split −3x as −4x + x: x² − 4x + x − 4 = x(x − 4) + 1(x − 4) = (x − 4)(x + 1). The zeroes are 4 and −1. Time x ≥ 0, so x = −1 is rejected and the start-up breaks even after 4 years. Sum of zeroes 3 = −b/a and product −4 = c/a.
solutionSteps: (c) Time cannot be negative, so x = −1 is rejected; break-even occurs at x = 4 years. [1]
fields.strategyHint: Split the middle term to factorise, then reject zeroes that make no sense in the real-world context.
fields.finalAnswer: (a) (x − 4)(x + 1). (b) 4 and −1. (c) x = 4 years is the only meaningful break-even time; sum 3 = −b/a, product −4 = c/a.
